items.title: OAuth authentication for webhook destinations will soon be available by default for workspaces with the compliance security profile enabled
items.text: Starting on or after December 20, 2026, OAuth authentication for webhook destinations will be available by default for workspaces with the compliance security profile enabled, subject to the requirements for regions and compliance standards. Use OAuth 2.0 client credentials to send notifications to an endpoint that requires an access token. Azure Databricks obtains the token from the configured OAuth token endpoint and uses it to authenticate the notification request. Existing webhook destinations retain their configured authentication. See OAuth authentication for webhook destinations.

items.title: ai_forecast version 2 is now generally available
items.text: Version 2 of the ai_forecast function is now generally available in Databricks SQL. A research-optimized time series foundation model powers version 2 for improved out-of-the-box accuracy, and version 2 adds built-in holiday support, external covariates, and non-negative forecasts. See ai_forecast function.

items.title: Genie Ontology snippets will soon be generally available and enabled by default
items.text: In early November 2026, Genie Ontology snippets will be generally available and enabled by default. Genie Ontology automatically extracts and maintains business context from your existing assets and usage, including metric views, dashboards, SQL queries, and Genie Agents. Genie One and Genie Code search the most relevant snippets from assets you have permission to access, improving response accuracy and speed. See Genie Ontology.

items.id: /release-notes/2026/other/2026-11-20-dynamic-tables-auto-resolves-to-adaptive#Nov 20, 2026: AUTO refresh mode for dynamic tables resolves to ADAPTIVE
items.title: Nov 20, 2026: AUTO refresh mode for dynamic tables resolves to ADAPTIVE
items.text: When you create a dynamic table with REFRESHMODE = AUTO (the default), Snowflake now resolves the refresh mode to ADAPTIVE instead of INCREMENTAL when the definition supports incremental refresh. If the definition isn't compatible with incremental refresh, AUTO still resolves to FULL.

items.text: With this release, COPY INTO and Snowpipe can keep invalid rows out of your tables and record the rows that they reject, so you can find and fix bad data with SQL. Error logging and CHECK constraint enforcement for [](/sql-reference/sql/copy-into-table) and Snowpipe are now generally available.

items.title: Nov 19, 2026: Snowflake Data Clean Rooms updates
items.text: Clean Rooms API Version: 19.5 The following updates are now available in Snowflake Data Clean Rooms: Stricter validation for free-form SQL policies: The freeform_sql_policies section of a data offering specification must now name at least one policy. Previously, a section that named no policy could satisfy the require_freeform_sql_policy check without attaching any policy to the data. Specifications with a freeform_sql_policies section that doesn't name a policy are now rejected with a validation error, so you can correct the specification before the data offering is shared. Security enhancements, including hardened input handling and updated third-party libraries. General performance improvements and bug fixes.
